st: We're Alcoholics, But We're Great Parents

st: My Husband's Cheating Went Viral Pt. 1
d: When Jenaye posted an emotional video online about uncovering her husband James's infidelity she never imagined it would go viral. Discovering James slept with his hairstylist on their fifth anniversary, Jenaye says divorce might be the best option.

st: A Catfish Investigation: My Mom Is Being Scammed Pt.1
